description: This file defines an abstract class 'DurableGrain' for the Orleans framework, managing state machine interactions within grain lifecycle, including creation, registration, and state writing logic.

classes.name: DurableGrain
classes.description: An abstract base class for Orleans grains that manages durable state machines and their lifecycle participation.

methods.name: DurableGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the state machine manager and participates in lifecycle if applicable.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStateMachine
methods.description: Retrieves an existing state machine by name or creates and registers a new one of specified type.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes the current state using the state machine manager.
